cs.t: I have the previous generation NUC, a NUC7i5BNH, as my home computer.  I put it in a Akasa fanless case, and it's wonderful — it's completely silent. I use Kubuntu, since I've been using KDE for 15 years. I use 5% of the configuration options — just by looking, you'd think it was a default install — but I really miss that 5% if I'm on a Mac or Windows.
